headline: MO Q2 Deep Dive: Margin Pressure Amid Consumer Strain and Smoke-Free Investments
summary: Tobacco company Altria (NYSE:MO) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 1.2% year on year to $5.36 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.48 per share was 1.2% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
